headline: HGM-Dual reports more accurate long-horizon planning harnesses under a fixed evaluation budget
summary: HGM-Dual is a harness-search method that summarizes the effects of earlier edits along a lineage and uses observed constraint failures to generate targeted alternatives alongside a general edit. In author-reported DeepPlanning travel and shopping evaluations, it improves case accuracy over a customized HGM baseline at 4,000 plan evaluations; on shopping it exceeds that baseline’s 4,000-evaluation result with 1,000 evaluations. These are results on two constrained tasks with fixed model choices. Appendix API costs cover task-agent evaluations and depend on cache assumptions; they do not establish total optimization cost or general planning capability.
